ST_CASE, VEH_NO, PER_NO
Refers to
ST_CASE → accident
ST_CASE, VEH_NO → vehicle, when PER_TYP is 1, 2 or 9
ST_CASE, VEH_NO → parkwork, when PER_TYP is 3

One row per person involved: occupants of motor vehicles, and non-motorists. (ST_CASE, VEH_NO) refers to the vehicle table for occupants of vehicles in transport (PER_TYP 1, 2, 9) and to the parkwork table for occupants of parked or working vehicles (PER_TYP 3); VEH_NO is 0 for non-motorists.
